title: The Audio Guide That Spoiled the Surprise
scene: At a small exhibition, a friend presses play on an audio guide at the wrong exhibit and confidently describes a painting that isn't there.
sceneJa: 小さな展覧会で友人が別の展示の音声ガイドを再生。目の前にない絵を自信満々に解説してしまう。

chunks.en: We were looking at a sculpture
chunks.ja: 私たちは彫刻を見ていた
そのとき友人が再生ボタンを押した
ナレーターは延々と語り始めた
絵画の劇的な色彩について、

chunks.en: because we were staring at a chair.
chunks.ja: 私たちが椅子を見つめていたからだ。
考え深そうにうなずいた。

chunks.en: I was about to correct him,
chunks.ja: 訂正しようとしたところ、
「筆づかいが驚くほど立体的だね」。
そこでようやく気づいた。
友人はちゃんと分かっていて
別の音声を流していたのだ。
ちょっとした芸術的な味わいがあった。

questions.question: Which grouping keeps the expression intact?
options: went on about / the painting's dramatic colors
questions.explanation: Go on about something means to talk at length, often more than necessary.

questions.question: What does 'played along' mean here?
options: 音声をもう一度再生した
相手の冗談に合わせて振る舞った
展示を見ずに先へ進んだ
questions.explanation: Play along means to cooperate with a pretense or joke.

questions.question: Why does the friend praise the brushwork of a chair?
options: He genuinely believes it is a painting.
He is joking about the mismatched audio guide.
He wants to complain to the museum.
questions.explanation: His deliberately absurd remark shows he is in on the joke.

speak: In 30 seconds, tell a story about someone confidently describing the wrong thing. Use 'went on about', 'played along', and finish with a dry joke.
review: New: go on about ...（〜について長々と語る）, play along（話を合わせる）, artistic flair（芸術的な味わい）. Review: I was about to ...（〜するところだった）, It dawned on me（ふと気づいた）, To be fair（公平に言えば）. Read aloud: pause after 'which was odd'; deliver the final line with a straight face.
